title: A reptilian being appears in Barbara Lamb's living room

tellings.quote: then one afternoon she she came out of her garden into her house and here was this reptilian guy

plain: One afternoon, Barbara Lamb, a therapist who works with people reporting alien encounters, came in from her garden and found a reptilian being standing in her house. Dan Sheehan, a lawyer, passes this on to Jesse Michels as something she told him. He mentions it alongside John Mack, the Harvard psychiatrist who studied people reporting abductions, and an archive of Lamb's recorded sessions. Told this way, it suggests the beings her clients describe came to her directly too.
